svg.title: Pull (tp::pull): the tractor, the chain and the sled

g.text: Pull (tp::pull): the tractor, the chain and the sled
+start_y_m : double (the sled across the lane, + left)
+sled_start_m() : double, the sled's rear wheels at the start
+start_line_m() : double, the sled's front at the start
+start_y_m() : double, where the sled and tractor start across
+step(State&, const Model&, const vehicle::Input&, dt_s) : Output
the chain pulls only when stretched, along its own line:
backwards and down/up on the tractor's hitch,
forwards and up/down on the sled's hook;
the tractor feels it in its body frame (pull, lift, side);
the sled follows the tractor's line sideways (hook behind the hitch);
unhooked the chain pulls neither end; a held sled stands still;
one driving back goes its own way (sled::drive_back), to its start;
both start at start_y_m across the lane, in line, straight;
the ground per contact: each rear side's, the front pair's,
